files.src/tunables.json:
{
  "about": "Live-tunable constants (README, \"Tunables\"): numbers to try out in the running game, from the browser's and the native overlay's Tunables panel or `/tune NAME VALUE`, without rebuilding it. The game reads each as `tune.value tunables.FIELD`, its name with underscores for dots; its value is game state. Bake writes the values tried back here as the defaults. Each has a name, a default within min..max, and may have a step for its slider and a doc. Adding one needs a build; tuning one does not.",
  "tunables": [
    {
      "name": "camera.zoom_speed",
      "default": 0.001,
      "min": 0.0002,
      "max": 0.005,
      "step": 0.0001,
      "doc": "How far a wheel unit zooms the camera while playing, as a share of its distance."
    },
    {
      "name": "camera.pan_speed",
      "default": 0.8,
      "min": 0.1,
      "max": 4,
      "step": 0.05,
      "doc": "How fast WASD pan the camera while playing, in camera distances a second; Shift is three times as fast."
    },
    {
      "name": "gnorps.haul_speed",
      "default": 1.6,
      "min": 0.2,
      "max": 8,
      "step": 0.1,
      "doc": "How fast gnorps walk on errands (hauling salt, to a building site, home at night), in metres a second."
    },
    {
      "name": "salt.per_strike",
      "default": 1,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 8,
      "step": 0.25,
      "doc": "The salt a strike knocks out of the rock, as a multiple of what its dent gives: 1, 2, 4, then 8 bricks as it deepens."
    },
    {
      "name": "wind.least_wait",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 0.25,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.25,
      "doc": "The fewest seconds between gusts of wind."
    },
    {
      "name": "wind.most_wait",
      "default": 12,
      "min": 0.25,
      "max": 120,
      "step": 0.25,
      "doc": "The most seconds between gusts of wind."
    }
  ]
}
